name: Rusty Spade
lore: Every dig starts with the first shovelful.

name: Oak Staff
lore: Good for walking. Better for leaning.

name: Garden Fork
lore: Four tines for stubborn ground.

name: Miner's Pick
lore: For the days that are mostly rock.

name: Barrow Blade
lore: Buried with care, a long time ago.

name: Wayfinder's Crook
lore: It carries its own small dawn.

name: Moonsteel Spade
lore: Forged cold. It parts frozen earth like water.

name: Oathkeeper
lore: Sworn to finish whatever it starts.

name: Wool Cap
lore: Knitted by someone who worried about your ears.

name: Straw Hat
lore: Shade you can wear.

name: Candle Helm
lore: One small flame, pointed wherever you look.

name: Fogcloak Hood
lore: The mist parts a little less for you now.

name: Barrow Helm
lore: Whoever wore it first stood very straight.

name: Moonsteel Cap
lore: Cool to the touch, even at noon.

name: Crown of Roots
lore: It was growing down there. It still is.

name: Patched Tunic
lore: More patch than tunic. Every one a story.

name: Digger's Apron
lore: Pockets for everything you find.

name: Travel Cloak
lore: Smells faintly of rain and campfire.

name: Ringmail
lore: A thousand small circles, each one holding.

name: Warden's Coat
lore: Brass buttons, polished by habit.

name: Moonsteel Plate
lore: Light as a held breath.

name: Foxfire Mantle
lore: The hem glows where it brushes the ground.

name: Pot Lid
lore: It has stopped soup. It can stop this.

name: Plank Shield
lore: Three boards and stubbornness.

name: Round Buckler
lore: Small, quick, and louder than it looks.

name: Spadecrest Shield
lore: The mark of those who keep digging.

name: Moon Mirror
lore: It shows the night sky, even indoors.

name: Lucky Pebble
lore: Found, not bought. That is the luck.

name: Firefly
lore: It decided to follow you.

name: Dusk Moth
lore: Loves your lantern more than you do.

name: Ember Wisp
lore: A spark that learned to stay lit.

name: Foxfire Wisp
lore: Cold light from old wood.

name: Pocket Moon
lore: It waxes when you do.
